label: prf:categorical-neutron-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical neutron
html:
Proof. Proof of uniqueness of the categorical neutron

Proof. The argument is identical to that for the uniqueness of the categorical proton, applying the partition (\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}, \mathfrak{d}). The Hecke normal form in H_3(q) is unique. The S_3-colour symmetry relates the three position assignments via inner automorphisms. Furthermore, the LP-optimal two-gluon stabiliser uniquely minimizes |\mathrm{tr}_M|.
